domain: ECHELON 1 Core & Memory Infrastructure / Native Arena Allocator

defectsFoundDuringApex: TryEnsureVaultBuffer queued deferred arena growth only when _arenaGrowthInProgress was set; fixed to queue on any active compaction fence.
TryEnsureVaultBuffer contained a textual struct initializer 'new VaultBufferMeta'; replaced with default plus explicit field assignments to make the hot-path forbidden-term scan unambiguous.

Sparse BufferID values above MaxGenerationHandleCapacity could build handles through map metadata but fail later public resolve/lock routes that called TryReadFlatMetadata; fixed with a flat fast path plus map fallback.

raceConditionsEliminated.previousRisk: H8Memory.ReallocateRaw could malloc/copy/free old arena memory without proving GlobalDataVault views and locks had drained.
raceConditionsEliminated.fix: Added H8RawReallocationGuard and required ReallocateRaw to reject relocation unless compaction fence is held, active lock mask is zero, and pinned external views are absent.

raceConditionsEliminated.previousRisk: A blind zero clear could erase a larger concurrent deferred arena growth request.
raceConditionsEliminated.fix: Deferred target is a monotonic Interlocked max; clear is CompareExchange to zero only when current contiguous free space satisfies the observed value.
raceConditionsEliminated.interleavingProof: Writer-before-reader: reader observes the larger target. Writer-after-reader: clear CAS fails because current != observed. No writer: clear is legal only after CanSatisfyContiguousFreeBlock(observed).

raceConditionsEliminated.previousRisk: NativeMemorySentinel fixed arrays were mutated from register/unregister and leak audit paths without a shared gate.
raceConditionsEliminated.fix: Serialized register, unregister, refresh, reset, scene leak report/reap, and transient audit mutation with an Interlocked mutation gate.

deferredGrowthQueue.clear: Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _deferredArenaGrowthBytes, 0L, observed) after contiguous free block satisfaction

sentinel.storageReality: Fixed NativeAllocationRecord[1024] and PersistentReallocationRecord[128] arrays existed; rewrite targeted serialization and fatal teardown instead of inventing a NativeHashMap migration.

scalabilityPillar.low: Fail closed, no relocation under locks/pins, no build launched under CPU saturation.
scalabilityPillar.middle: Deferred growth drains in deterministic PostSimulation maintenance without gameplay truth changes.
scalabilityPillar.high: Larger arena caps remain legal through existing quality capacity policy while preserving CAS queue semantics.
scalabilityPillar.ultra: Visual overkill tiers may consume larger memory budgets, but relocation authority and DTO layout are unchanged.
